description: The constantly zero binary sequence has prefix-code set {2^n : n is natural}. Its intersection with the constantly one sequence is {1}, and its intersection with the sequence whose only 1 is at index 1 is {1,2}.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.AlmostDisjointFamilies.prefix_examples :
  ((Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.prefixCodes fun x => false) = Set.range fun n => 2 ^ n) ∧
    ((Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.prefixCodes fun x => false) ∩
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.prefixCodes fun x => true) =
        {1} ∧
      ((Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.prefixCodes fun x => false) ∩
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.prefixCodes fun n => n == 1) =
        {1, 2}
